phase: BNR BLS May-2025 XLSX Offline Layout Review
inspection_method: artifact_tool SpreadsheetFile.import_xlsx + worksheet/range inspection; no workbook mutation

nfc_credit_standards.sign_convention: positive = net tightening; negative = net easing

nfc_loan_demand.sign_convention: positive = net increase in demand; negative = net decrease

household_mortgage_credit_standards.sign_convention: positive = net tightening; negative = net easing

household_consumer_credit_standards.sign_convention: positive = net tightening; negative = net easing

household_mortgage_loan_demand.sign_convention: positive = net increase in demand; negative = net decrease

household_consumer_loan_demand.sign_convention: positive = net increase in demand; negative = net decrease

mortgage_term_question.label: Maximum debt service to monthly income (lower = tightening; higher = easing)
mortgage_term_question.response_type: change in a lending term, reported as bank-response distribution/net percentage

consumer_term_question.label: Maximum debt service to monthly income (lower = tightening; higher = easing)
consumer_term_question.response_type: change in a lending term, reported as bank-response distribution/net percentage

dsti_semantic_check.conclusion: These workbook fields are not levels of borrower DSTI and must not be substituted for the average/new-loan/outstanding-loan DSTI levels discussed in BNR stability reports.

history_boundary.interpretation: The workbook provides a deterministic schema and one realised survey round, not the multi-quarter historical BLS series required for structural selection.
history_boundary.legacy_archive_status: Historical 2023-2025 XLS bytes are retained separately, but no canonical artifact_tool extraction path exists for OLE2 XLS.
